answerCheck.reason: ad-bc = 1×1-1×1 = 0, while the denominator is 2⁴ = 16. Therefore χ² = 4×0²/16 = 0.
n = 50, ad-bc = 400-25 = 375, and all four marginal totals equal 25. Thus χ² = 50×375²/25⁴ = 18.
n = 10 and ad-bc = 16-1 = 15. Each marginal total is 5, so χ² = 10×15²/5⁴ = 2250/625 = 18/5.
